description: Cold-start candidate pool for the BDR agent. Real public companies in LatAm large-scale lithium/copper/iron-ore mining, used as the seed list for the Account Discovery agent (a BDR also starts from a seed list; the agent live-verifies every account against the ICP with evidence before it qualifies). The reference account (SQM) is excluded here and used only as the ICP anchor.
